changes: defaults
The default DH groups for Phase1 and Phase2 IPsec VPN tunnels is updated from 14 and 5 to 20 and 21 when configured from the CLI.
defaults
An SD-WAN passive health-check does not need to be configured for application performance monitoring to work.
defaults
On FortiGates with NP7 processors, the default setting for vlan-lookup-cache has been changed to disable, and the htab-msg-queue mode is now set to dedicated.
defaults
Form authentication no longer works without Captive Portal in transparent web mode.
defaults
With asymroute-icmp and asymroute6-icmp enabled, ICMP replies are no longer strictly routed back through the same interface they arrived on.
defaults
IPSec IKEv2 dial-up tunnel no longer installs a default route when no IP can be allocated from the pool.
defaults
When auth-ike-saml-port is used, iprope will match the local-in traffic only when the destination port is auth-ike-saml-port and the destination interface has ike-saml-server enabled.
defaults
Added default inclusion of the FortiOS device serial number in the CSR subject (set csr- include-device-sn enable).
defaults
The default auto-update schedule for FortiGuard packages has been changed from automatic to daily.
defaults
When Anycast is enabled, VM license activation now uses dedicated activation FQDNs (vmactivation1/2/3.fortinet.net) instead of general update FQDNs, resulting in faster and more reliable activation.
defaults
Configuration revisions are now only available on FortiGate models with a disk. revision- backup-on-logout is enabled by default (previously disabled).
defaults

The default setting for allow-traffic-redirect and ipv6-allow-traffic-redirect has been changed from enable to disable: config system global set allow-traffic-redirect disable set ipv6-allow-traffic-redirect disable end…
defaults
Default user authentication settings (config user setting) has changed to enable only HTTP firewall policy authentication and HTTP redirection to HTTPS.
defaults
FortiGate now by default only shows recommended configurations for IKE proposals in the CLI.
defaults
The default value of the streaming-content-scan-type setting under config firewall profile-protocol-options > config http is changed to include octet.
defaults
FortiGate operating in GovRamp (previously called StateRAMP) mode will use dedicated FortiGuard NTP servers as the default configuration after a factory reset.
defaults

In NGFW policy-based mode, traffic may be bypassed when the IPS engine is not running such as when FortiGate first boots up, the IPS engine is upgrading or when it is manually stopped with debug commands.
defaults
Inline IPS is now disabled by default.
defaults
Additional commands are allowed before device registration to accommodate users that require configuring the device for central management, ZTP and LTP.
defaults

The default MTU for IPsec tunnel interfaces has been changed from 1420 to 1402 on the following FortiGate models: FG-5xG, FG-7xG, FG-9xG, FG-12xG, FG-20xG, FG-40xF, FG-60xF, FG-70xG, FG-90xG, FG- 100xF, FG-180xF,…
cli
The NP7 session accounting interval range is now 1 to 600 seconds.
cli
Add IPv6 address pool support in explicit proxy policies: config firewall proxy-policy edit <id> set poolname6 <name> next end
cli

You can enable the following option to add all multicast traffic denied by a firewall policy to the session table: config system settings set ses-denied-multicast-traffic enable end Enabling this option can affect CPU…
cli
When multi-vdom mode is disabled, hide the settings: config endpoint-control settings set override {enable | disable} end
cli
If your FortiGate with NP7 processors is terminating VXLAN-over-IPsec connections, you may notice traffic drops during broadcast storms.
cli
NP7 traffic anomaly protection for TCP, UDP, and ICMP checksum error detection now includes the option to allow TCP, UDP, and ICMPpackets with incorrect checksums.
cli
The encrypted DNS certificate configuration behavior has been updated.
cli
Enhance the CLI command diagnose ip router bgp show to include disabled items as well as the enabled items.
cli

When captive portal is not enabled, these settings are hidden: config authentication setting set captive-portal-port set captive-portal-ssl-port set auth-https end To change these settings, first enable captive portal.
cli
When configuring a VPN from CLI, a warning is displayed to inform administrators not to use IKEv1 for their IPsec Phase1 configuration.
cli

Support IPv6 BGP route dampening by introducing these CLI commands: config router bgp set dampening6 {enable|disable} set dampening6-route-map <string> set dampening6-reachability-half-life <integer> set…
cli
The CLI attribute hw-model has been renamed to hw-version under config firewall address for device identification dynamic addresses.
cli
The intra-vap-privacy setting has been removed from local-bridging vap.
cli
In Agentless VPN settings, when multiple domains in dns-suffix are configured, parse each entry separated by ";".
cli
The FortiGate 120G and 121G port17 to port24 interface speed can be changed to 100Mbps.
cli
The SFP speed detect CLI option has been updated, replacing auto-module with detect-by- module for improved clarity.
cli
Added enforce-preferred-source BGP neighbor option to ensure the BGP session source IP (update-source) is used as the preferred source for IPv4 routes learned from the neighbor.
cli
Supports file encryption on SCP config backups: scp -OT admin@<FGT_IP>:encrypted-config:<encryption_password> <dst file>
cli
The system.5g-modem CLI and all its references has been renamed to system.cellular-modem to support current and future cellular technologies.
gui
On a new installation, users logging into the GUI are directed to the FortiCare registration dialog.
gui
In LDAP configurations in the GUI, default to using STARTTLS, and hide the option to disable secure connection.
gui
To facilitate configuring proxy arp address ranges for FortiSwitch VLANs, the GUI now supports adding proxy arp address ranges for VLAN type interfaces.
gui
On IPsec VPN configurations, the GUI will only provide options to set Auto or UDP for Transport mode.
table
Increase extension-controller.extender size for FGT-200G and higher end to 512 to support more lan-extension connections.
table
The per-VDOM table size for firewall.internet-service-custom has been updated to align with firewall.service.custom.
table
The FortiOS Carrier maximum tunnel limit configurable for GTP profiles and global GTP settings has been increased from 16,000,000 to 50,000,000.
table

The table size limits for user.group:member and user.local on HighEnd FortiGate models have been increased, with user.group:member raised from 3000 to 35000 and user.local expanded from 5000 to 35000, improving…
table
The global table size for system.external-resource has been updated from 512 entries to a memory-based capacity, removing the fixed global limit.
table
Increase per-vdom limit for router.route-map from 256 to 512.
table
Increased the maximum table entry limits for ZTNA and access proxy objects to improve scalability for larger customer deployments.
